data.body: Change 2459 (Phase 2) re-pushed as PS4 (a8c47a6e6057), now rebased directly onto merged P1 (22d4d4fc) — unstacked. Fixed the blocking LLM-Review finding: verify_completion_status no longer reports 'certified' off a bare HMAC verify. It now loads ticket state (_reads.show_ticket) and routes the verdict/ok/reason through compute_validity(sig, state, 'completion-verifier'), structurally identical to how plan_review_status defers to claim_gate_check. A STALE/REOPENED completion attestation now reports its lifecycle verdict (stale-reopened / stale-material / not-closed) instead of a false 'certified'. This also fixes gate_status's 'durable' field, which reads through the same function. Teeth: new test test_verify_completion_status_reports_stale_for_a_reopened_attestation is RED against the bare-sig code (reads certified/ok) and GREEN after routing through compute_validity (verdict=stale-reopened, ok=False). Coverage advisories done: (1) test_gate_status_surfaces_the_durable_completion_verdict asserts durable present+certified for a completion job; (2) test_gate_status_within_grace_window_still_reads_running covers the in-grace branch of _resolve_status; (3) test_follower_start_does_not_reclobber_the_leaders_index_record directly asserts the is_new guard (leader records 'running' once; a follower during in-flight records nothing). Updated the two verified_at_sha tests to supply a closed ticket state. make lint + make typecheck green; complexity new=0 increased=0; ARG ratchet 25; module sizes 226/573<800; no docs/mcp-reference.md drift. 21 gate-async tests + dedup + schema-coverage suites green. Awaiting re-review.
